scope: Five BRCA candidate sites with measured retrospective data, reviewed manufacturer specificity, and exact human RefSeq/UniProt windows; not exhaustive RPPA500 validation.

sites.evidence_note: Human reactivity and Ser65 specificity are reported; immunogen was mouse sequence.
Human reactivity and Thr70 specificity are reported; immunogen was rat sequence.
Manufacturer identifies phosphorylated human ATM Ser1981.
Manufacturer explicitly maps historical Ser445 to current human Ser446. Total antibody is RPPA-release Valid; vendor also reports extra bands in an unpurified WB comparison.
Manufacturer identifies phosphoinositide-dependent kinase PDPK1 Ser241, not pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase PDK1.

exclusions.reason: Manufacturer reports potential SRC-family and phosphorylated receptor-kinase cross-reactivity; not a single SRC site measurement.
Manufacturer reports possible YES/FYN/FGR/YRK cross-reactivity; not a single SRC site measurement.
Manufacturer detects both p70 T389 and p85 T412 and potentially S6KII T388; no single-isoform equivalence.
Histone-family epitope not proven H3C1-specific; neighboring K9 modification affects binding.

limitations: Manufacturer specificity and sequence matches are supporting evidence, not new experimental validation of this RPPA batch.
No assumption that a pan-family antibody equals a single phosphoproteomic feature.
Unreviewed features remain outside this pilot; they are retained in the full mapping table.
